title: points.json (plan bundle)
description: Named points of the plan in pad-local metres: the pad, every station of stations.json (its science point) and its access cell for the plan's scenario. x, y from lon/lat by the bundle frame's projection; z = terrain under the point (world pack near chunks, bilinear; far grid elsewhere) minus the pad elevation; null when no terrain covers it. Station names, objectives, tasks, dwell and partner-line status stay in planner/stations.json (same ids).
x-source: handover page part A (stations.json, pad.json positions); contracts/bundle/README.md
